title: Listening: planning a trip
goal: Understand two friends planning a holiday, and notice the present perfect for experiences, the past simple for a story, going to, would like to and will for plans, and possessive pronouns.
goal_it: Capire due amici che organizzano una vacanza e notare il present perfect per le esperienze, il past simple per una storia, going to, would like to e will per i progetti e i pronomi possessivi.

steps.title: Today's situation
en: You will hear two friends, Mia and Tom, planning a holiday abroad. Mia has found a cheap flight. They talk about places they have been to, about something that went wrong on a past trip, and about what they are going to do next.
Listen for three things: why Mia chose this place, what happened to Tom on his last flight, and who is going to do what. First, learn the words below.
it: Sentirai due amici, Mia e Tom, che organizzano una vacanza all'estero. Mia ha trovato un volo economico. Parlano dei posti dove sono stati, di qualcosa che e' andato storto in un viaggio passato e di cio' che faranno ora.
Ascolta tre cose: perche' Mia ha scelto questo posto, cosa e' successo a Tom nell'ultimo volo e chi fara' cosa. Prima impara le parole qui sotto.

steps.title: Words you need
en: Learn these words before you listen.
it: Impara queste parole prima di ascoltare.

steps.title: Experiences, plans and quick decisions
steps.title_it: Esperienze, progetti e decisioni al momento
en: When we plan a trip we mix several tenses. Present perfect for experiences up to now: Have you ever been to Porto? I've never been there. Past simple for a story that is finished: Last year the airline lost my suitcase.

For the future we choose by meaning. be going to = a plan already decided: We're going to take only hand luggage. would like to / I'd like = a wish: I'd like a small hotel. will = a decision at the moment of speaking: I'll phone her now.
Notice also the possessive pronouns: The blue bag is mine. Yours is the black one.
it: Quando si organizza un viaggio si mescolano piu' tempi. Present perfect per le esperienze fino a ora: Have you ever been to Porto? I've never been there. Past simple per una storia finita: Last year the airline lost my suitcase.

Per il futuro si sceglie in base al significato. be going to = un progetto gia' deciso: We're going to take only hand luggage. would like to / I'd like = un desiderio: I'd like a small hotel. will = una decisione presa sul momento: I'll phone her now.
Nota anche i pronomi possessivi: The blue bag is mine. Yours is the black one.

head: Meaning
Example
rows: We're going to take hand luggage.

examples.en: I've already booked the hotel, so we're going to arrive on Friday.
examples.it: Ho gia' prenotato l'albergo, quindi arriveremo venerdi'.

options: a small bag you carry onto the plane
a large suitcase that goes in the hold
the bag you buy at the airport
a bag that holds only your passport
steps.why: Hand luggage is the bag you keep with you on the plane.
steps.why_it: Hand luggage e' il bagaglio che tieni con te in aereo.

steps.q: I've already bought the tickets. We ___ visit my aunt in Leeds in August.
steps.q_it: Ho gia' comprato i biglietti. Faremo visita a mia zia a Leeds in agosto.
options: will
would like
are going to
have
steps.why: A plan that is already decided: be going to.
steps.why_it: Un progetto gia' deciso: be going to.

steps.q: The phone is ringing. I ___ (answer) it!
steps.why: A decision made at the moment of speaking: will.

steps.q: Is this my ticket or your ticket? This one is ___.
steps.q_it: Questo e' il mio biglietto o il tuo? Questo e' ___.
steps.why: Pronoun without a noun, for you: yours.
steps.why_it: Pronome senza nome, riferito a you: yours.

steps.title: Listen to the conversation
en: Press Listen. You can listen as many times as you like. Try to find out: Why does Mia want Porto? What went wrong on Tom's last flight? Who is going to do what now?
it: Premi Ascolta. Puoi riascoltare quante volte vuoi. Cerca di capire: perche' Mia vuole Porto? Cosa e' andato storto nell'ultimo volo di Tom? Chi fara' cosa ora?

script.speaker: Mia
script.text: Tom, I've just found a really cheap flight to Porto. Have you ever been there?
script.it: Tom, ho appena trovato un volo davvero economico per Porto. Ci sei mai stato?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: No, never. My brother has been twice, and he says the food is amazing. Why Porto?
script.it: No, mai. Mio fratello ci e' stato due volte e dice che il cibo e' fantastico. Perche' Porto?

script.speaker: Mia
script.text: We need a holiday in May, and I'd like to see somewhere new. I've already been to Lisbon, and it rained all week.
script.it: Ci serve una vacanza a maggio e mi piacerebbe vedere un posto nuovo. Sono gia' stata a Lisbona e ha piovuto tutta la settimana.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: So you want better weather this time! I'm a bit nervous about flying, though. Last year the airline lost my suitcase on the way to Rome.
script.it: Quindi vuoi un tempo migliore questa volta! Pero' sono un po' agitato per il volo. L'anno scorso la compagnia aerea ha perso la mia valigia mentre andavo a Roma.

script.speaker: Mia
script.text: I remember. You got it back on Friday, didn't you?
script.it: Me lo ricordo. L'hai riavuta venerdi', vero?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Yes, but I wore the same shirt for four days.
script.it: Si', ma ho portato la stessa camicia per quattro giorni.

script.speaker: Mia
script.text: This time we're going to take only hand luggage. Then nothing can get lost.
script.it: Questa volta porteremo solo il bagaglio a mano. Cosi' niente si puo' perdere.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Good idea. Is that blue bag yours, or mine?
script.it: Buona idea. Quella borsa blu e' tua o mia?

script.speaker: Mia
script.text: The blue one is mine. Yours is the black one by the door.
script.it: La blu e' mia. La tua e' quella nera vicino alla porta.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Right. Where are we going to stay? I'd like a small hotel near the river.
script.it: Giusto. Dove alloggeremo? Mi piacerebbe un piccolo albergo vicino al fiume.

script.speaker: Mia
script.text: My sister stayed there two years ago. I'll phone her now and ask for a name.
script.it: Mia sorella ha alloggiato li' due anni fa. La chiamo adesso e le chiedo un nome.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Great. And I'll book the flights tonight, before the price goes up.
script.it: Perfetto. E io prenoto i voli stasera, prima che il prezzo salga.

steps.q: Why does Tom say 'So you want better weather this time!'?
steps.q_it: Perche' Tom dice 'So you want better weather this time!'?
options: He thinks Mia is afraid of flying
He guesses Mia wants to avoid another rainy trip
He wants to go to Lisbon instead
He is complaining about the weather in May
steps.why: Mia says it rained all week in Lisbon. Tom understands that she hopes for better weather in Porto.
steps.why_it: Mia dice che a Lisbona ha piovuto tutta la settimana. Tom capisce che spera in un tempo migliore a Porto.

steps.q: Why is Tom a bit nervous about the trip?
steps.q_it: Perche' Tom e' un po' agitato per il viaggio?
options: He has never been abroad
He is afraid of bad weather
He does not like Mia's choice of city
The last time he flew, his suitcase was lost
steps.why: He says: last year the airline lost my suitcase. The nervousness is about flying, not about Porto.
steps.why_it: Dice: l'anno scorso la compagnia ha perso la mia valigia. L'agitazione riguarda il volo, non Porto.

steps.q: What does Tom mean when he says 'I wore the same shirt for four days'?
steps.q_it: Cosa intende Tom con 'I wore the same shirt for four days'?
options: He only likes one shirt
His suitcase arrived late, so he had no other clothes
His holiday lasted only four days
He forgot to pack more shirts
steps.why: He got the suitcase back on Friday, days after the flight. Until then he had nothing else to wear.
steps.why_it: Ha riavuto la valigia venerdi', giorni dopo il volo. Fino ad allora non aveva altro da mettere.

options: Mia has already been to Lisbon.
Tom's brother has visited Porto twice.
Tom has already booked the flights.
Mia's sister stayed in Porto two years ago.
steps.why: Tom says I'll book the flights tonight: he has not booked them yet. The other three are said in the conversation.
steps.why_it: Tom dice I'll book the flights tonight: non li ha ancora prenotati. Le altre tre sono dette nella conversazione.

options: the blue one
both bags
neither of them
the black one by the door
steps.why: Tom asks about the blue bag and Mia answers: the blue one is mine, yours is the black one.
steps.why_it: Tom chiede della borsa blu e Mia risponde: la blu e' mia, la tua e' quella nera.

steps.q: Why will Tom book the flights tonight?
steps.q_it: Perche' Tom prenotera' i voli stasera?
options: The flight is cheap now and the price may rise
Mia asked him to book them tonight
The airline is closing the booking
He wants to fly tomorrow
steps.why: He says: before the price goes up. The flight is cheap now.
steps.why_it: Dice: before the price goes up. Il volo ora costa poco.

steps.title: Listen again with the text
en: Listen again and read the text. Then answer the last questions.
it: Riascolta e leggi il testo. Poi rispondi alle ultime domande.

steps.q: How many times has Tom's brother been to Porto?
steps.q_it: Quante volte e' stato a Porto il fratello di Tom?
options: Once
Twice
Three times
Never
steps.why: You hear: My brother has been twice.
steps.why_it: Si sente: My brother has been twice.

steps.q: What are they going to take?
options: Two big suitcases
One big suitcase
A backpack each
Only hand luggage
steps.why: You hear: we're going to take only hand luggage.
steps.why_it: Si sente: we're going to take only hand luggage.
steps.audio: This time we're going to take only hand luggage.

answers: I have already been to Lisbon
steps.why: Present perfect: have already been, an experience up to now.
steps.why_it: Present perfect: have already been, un'esperienza fino a ora.

answers: Yours is the black one by the door
steps.why: Yours is the pronoun for you, with no noun.
steps.why_it: Yours e' il pronome per you, senza nome.
steps.audio: Yours is the black one by the door.

answers: I'd like a small hotel near the river
I would like a small hotel near the river
steps.why: I'd like = I would like, a wish.
steps.why_it: I'd like = I would like, un desiderio.
steps.audio: I'd like a small hotel near the river.

answers: I will book the flights tonight
steps.why: I'll = I will, a decision at the moment of speaking.
steps.why_it: I'll = I will, una decisione presa sul momento.

steps.title: Keep listening this week
en: Choose one short recording at B1 level and listen twice. The first time, listen without help. The second time, read the transcript if there is one.
BBC Learning English also has the programme 6 Minute English: you can find it in your podcast app.
it: Scegli una breve registrazione di livello B1 e ascoltala due volte. La prima volta senza aiuti. La seconda leggi la trascrizione, se c'e'.
Anche BBC Learning English ha il programma 6 Minute English: lo trovi nella tua app di podcast.
